import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).reset_index()

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='total', y='product', data=product_revenue, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Product', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
